sources.content: The fernhollow-render image runs Fernhollow, a service that turns Markdown documents into PDF files. It is based on alpine:3.20 and bundles the fonts needed for Latin, Greek, and Cyrillic text. The service exposes an HTTP API on port 8088. Send a POST request to /render with Markdown in the body and the service returns a PDF. The entrypoint is /app/fernhollow serve, and the container stops cleanly when it receives SIGTERM, finishing any render already in progress.

FERNHOLLOW_WORKERS sets how many documents render at once and defaults to 4. FERNHOLLOW_MAX_PAGES caps the length of a single output file and defaults to 200 pages; longer documents return an error. FERNHOLLOW_LOG_LEVEL accepts debug, info, warn, or error and defaults to info. Write temporary files to /tmp/fernhollow, which should be a tmpfs mount in production so that rendered documents never touch persistent disk.

claims.text: The fernhollow-render image is based on alpine:3.20.
The fernhollow-render service exposes its HTTP API on port 8080.
The fernhollow-render image bundles fonts for Cyrillic text.
The fernhollow-render service can render Markdown to HTML.
